Hi Ben -

Appreciate the follow-up and the attachments - quick answers below.

1) Evidence portal: our audit team prefers uploads to our vendor evidence portal (secure link) for anything non-sensitive; for items that include internal IP we'll accept an SFTP drop. For very sensitive artifacts we'll request a scoped NDA first.
2) SOC 2: we need to know if Redwood is currently SOC 2 Type II certified or if there is an audit in process. A statement of timing is acceptable for now (e.g., "Type II in progress, anticipated Q4 completion").
3) Incident response / breach notification: please send a short summary that includes your typical detection->notification->remediation timeline, who you notify internally and externally, and sample notification content (what fields you include).

We're on a tight timeline for the procurement review - if you can get SOC 2 status + the IR summary in the next two business days that would be great. I've looped security@fintechcorp.com for any follow-up clarifications.

Thanks,
Alex

Alex -

Thanks for the clarity. Quick deliveries below and attaching the short IR summary and our SOC 2 status note.

- SOC 2 status: Redwood is currently SOC 2 Type II in-process. The external audit fieldwork is scheduled for mid-November 2026; we expect an official report delivery in early December 2026. For procurement purposes we can provide our SOC 2 Type I report from 2025 and an attestation letter describing the audit timeline. (See attached: SOC2_Status_Note.pdf)

- Incident response summary (high level):
  * Detection & Triage: automated alerts -> security on-call within 15-30 minutes during business hours; 24/7 paging for severity-critical.
  * Containment: local containment steps executed within 1-2 hours for service-impacting incidents.
  * Notification: internal stakeholders notified within 2 hours for P1; external customers notified within 72 hours for confirmed data exposure incidents; we follow legal guidance and regulatory timelines for breach notifications (we work with counsel per-region).
  * Root cause & remediation: initial mitigation within 24-72 hours; full remediation and post-incident report generally within 7-14 business days depending on complexity.

- Attachments: IR_Summary.pdf (sample notification template + escalation contacts) and SOC2_Status_Note.pdf (Type I report + timeline).

If Fintech needs the artifacts uploaded to your portal, please share the secure link and we'll coordinate with our InfoSec ops (Jordan) to push the files. If an NDA is required for any artifact, loop Marissa and she'll take care of the legal routing.

Ben
